title: 第7章 剑试天人第8章 本世子要吃人
slug: 一剑惊天下可她身后的男人更可怕
content_zh:
武阁前。
怀安停下脚步，仰头打量着这座高阁。
“好一座武阁，”她轻声赞叹，“修得比父皇的无极楼还要气派。”
说着，她伸手推向阁门。
“什么人？竟敢擅闯武阁！”
阁门突然从内打开。
三道身影如鬼魅般掠出，拦在门前。
为首的是个穿黑衣的男子，面容冷峻，手持长剑，正是惊鸿卫白起。
身后两人同样黑衣，气息沉凝。
“三个第九境。”李寒衣站在怀安身后，淡淡开口。
怀安美目微眯，闪过一丝讶异。
南王府……还有这么多高手？
“大胆，”怀安冷声呵斥，目光如刀，“竟敢对本宫无礼！”
白起眉头紧皱，目光在怀安身上扫过，又落在她身后的李寒衣身上。
当察觉到李寒衣那深不可测的气息时，他瞳孔微微一缩。
天人境！
“公主？”白起声音低沉，“哪位公主？”
“本宫怀安。”怀安扬起下巴，“怎么，这武阁，本宫进不得？”
“武阁乃王府禁地，外人不得入内。”白起寸步不让，手中长剑微微抬起，“公主请回。”
怀安笑了，笑得明媚，眼底却一片冰冷。

她侧头看向李寒衣：“老师。”
李寒衣面无表情，只是抬手，并指如剑，朝白起虚虚一点。
没有风声，没有气劲，甚至没有杀意。
可白起三人却同时脸色剧变，仿佛被无形巨锤砸中胸膛，齐齐倒退三步，每一步都在青石地上踩出深深的脚印。
三人嘴角同时溢出血丝，握剑的手微微发抖。
只一指。
天人境与武夫，天壤之别。
怀安见状，唇角笑意更深。
她不再理会白起三人，抬脚便要踏入武阁。
就在此时……
“唰！唰！唰！”
武阁内，突然涌出二十余道身影。
清一色的黑衣，清一色的长剑，清一色的冰冷眼神。
他们如潮水般涌出，瞬间将怀安与李寒衣围在中央。
二十多道第九境的气息同时爆发，如二十多座小山同时压下，连空气都凝滞了。
怀安脸上的笑容终于僵住。
她环视四周，看着那二十多双冰冷的眼睛，心头第一次涌起寒意。
这么多第九境……
南王府，到底藏了多少底牌？
李寒衣眼中也闪过讶异。
content_en:
In front of the martial arts pavilion.
Huai'an stopped and looked up at the high pavilion.
"What a martial arts pavilion," she praised softly, "it is even more magnificent than my father's Wuji Pavilion."
As she said that, she stretched out her hand and pushed towards the door of the pavilion.
"Who is it? How dare you break into the martial arts pavilion!"
The pavilion door suddenly opened from inside.
Three figures flew out like ghosts and blocked the door.
The leader was a man in black, with a stern face and a long sword in his hand. He was none other than Jinghong Wei Bai Qi.
The two people behind them were also dressed in black, and their auras were solemn.
"Three ninth realms." Li Hanyi stood behind Huai'an and said calmly.
Huai'an's beautiful eyes narrowed slightly, with a hint of surprise flashing across his face.
Nanwangfu...there are so many masters?
"How dare you," Huai'an scolded coldly, his eyes like daggers, "how dare you be rude to me!"
Bai Qi frowned, his eyes swept over Huai'an, and then landed on Li Hanyi behind her.
When he noticed Li Hanyi's unfathomable aura, his pupils shrank slightly.
Realm of Heaven and Humanity!
"Princess?" Bai Qi said in a low voice, "Which princess?"
"I, Huai'an." Huai'an raised his chin, "Why, I can't enter this martial arts pavilion?"
"Wuge is a forbidden area of the palace, and outsiders are not allowed to enter." Bai Qi refused to give in, slightly raising the sword in his hand, "Princess, please come back."
Huai'an smiled brightly, but his eyes were cold.
She turned her head and looked at Li Hanyi: "Teacher."
Li Hanyi's face was expressionless, he just raised his hand and pointed it like a sword, pointing towards Bai Qi weakly.
There was no sound, no energy, not even murderous intent.
But the expressions of Bai Qi and the other three people changed dramatically at the same time, as if they were hit in the chest by an invisible giant hammer. They all took three steps back, each step leaving deep footprints on the bluestone ground.
The corners of the mouths of the three of them were bloodshot at the same time, and the hands holding the swords were trembling slightly.
Just one finger.
There is a world of difference between the realm of heaven and human beings and that of a martial artist.
When Huai'an saw this, the smile on his lips deepened.
She no longer paid attention to Bai Qi and the others, and stepped into the martial arts pavilion.
At this moment...
"Whoa! Whoa! Whoa!"
In the martial arts pavilion, more than twenty figures suddenly emerged.
All black clothes, all long swords, all cold eyes.
They poured out like a tide, instantly surrounding Huai'an and Li Hanyi in the center.
More than twenty auras of the ninth realm erupted at the same time, like more than twenty hills pressing down at the same time, even the air was stagnant.
The smile on Huai'an's face finally froze.
She looked around, looking at the more than twenty pairs of cold eyes, and felt a chill in her heart for the first time.
So many ninth realms...
How many trump cards does Nanwang Mansion hide?
Li Hanyi's eyes also flashed with surprise.
